translations.web: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.
translations.bsb: For even if I were right, I could not answer. I could only beg my Judge for mercy.
translations.kjv: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
translations.asv: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer; I would make supplication to my judge.
